## Summary
Build the at-risk student gap classifier that uses BFS traversal of the SubConcept prerequisite graph to classify student knowledge gaps as isolated, cluster, or systemic, enabling targeted intervention recommendations.

## User story
As a faculty advisor, I want to see which students are at-risk and whether their gaps are isolated, clustered around a prerequisite, or systemic across multiple systems, so that I can recommend appropriate interventions (targeted review vs. comprehensive remediation).

## Why this matters
A student with an isolated gap (one weak topic) needs very different support than a student with systemic gaps across 3+ USMLE systems. Without classification, advisors treat all struggling students the same, wasting remediation effort. The BFS traversal is critical: cluster detection requires finding shared prerequisite roots, which is a graph problem that cannot be solved with flat SQL queries.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] AtRiskClassifierService.classifyStudent() returns one of: systemic | cluster | isolated | on_track
- [ ] Weak threshold: p_mastery < 0.70 (from concept_mastery table)
- [ ] Systemic: >= 3 weak SubConcepts across >= 3 unrelated USMLE systems (no shared PREREQUISITE root)
- [ ] Cluster: >= 2 weak SubConcepts that share a common PREREQUISITE SubConcept (BFS finds shared root)
- [ ] Isolated: 1 weak SubConcept OR multiple weak SubConcepts with no prerequisite relationship
- [ ] On_track: zero weak SubConcepts
- [ ] DIF Category C items excluded from mastery computation before classification
- [ ] Neo4j queries use neo4jQuery wrapper (Rule 1)
- [ ] AtRiskDashboard shows student list with classification badges, weak concept count, recommended action
- [ ] API requires admin/faculty role

## Code patterns to follow
```typescript
// Pattern: BFS traversal via neo4jQuery (Rule 1)
// features/analytics/services/AtRiskClassifierService.ts
import { neo4jQuery } from '@journey/neo4j/client';

export class AtRiskClassifierService {
  static readonly WEAK_THRESHOLD = 0.70;

  static async findSharedPrerequisites(
    weakConceptIds: string[],
    institutionId: string,
  ): Promise<Map<string, string[]>> {
    // BFS via Cypher: find all PREREQUISITE ancestors for each weak concept
    const result = await neo4jQuery<{ conceptId: string; rootId: string }>(
      `UNWIND $conceptIds AS cid
       MATCH (sc:SubConcept {uuid: cid})-[:PREREQUISITE*1..5]->(root:SubConcept)
       RETURN sc.uuid AS conceptId, root.uuid AS rootId`,
      { conceptIds: weakConceptIds },
      institutionId,
    );
    // Group by shared roots to detect clusters
    return groupBySharedRoots(result);
  }

  static async getUSMLESystems(
    weakConceptIds: string[],
    institutionId: string,
  ): Promise<Map<string, string>> {
    const result = await neo4jQuery<{ conceptId: string; system: string }>(
      `UNWIND $conceptIds AS cid
       MATCH (sc:SubConcept {uuid: cid})-[:MAPS_TO]->(ut:USMLE_Subtopic)
       RETURN sc.uuid AS conceptId, ut.system AS system`,
      { conceptIds: weakConceptIds },
      institutionId,
    );
    return new Map(result.map(r => [r.conceptId, r.system]));
  }

  static classify(
    weakCount: number,
    sharedRoots: Map<string, string[]>,
    uniqueSystems: Set<string>,
  ): 'systemic' | 'cluster' | 'isolated' | 'on_track' {
    if (weakCount === 0) return 'on_track';
    if (weakCount >= 3 && uniqueSystems.size >= 3) return 'systemic';
    // Check if any root is shared by >= 2 weak concepts
    for (const [, concepts] of sharedRoots) {
      if (concepts.length >= 2) return 'cluster';
    }
    return 'isolated';
  }
}
```

## Automated tests (Playwright — runs during /validate)
```typescript
// tests/E09/E09-S04.api.test.ts
import { test, expect } from '@playwright/test';

test('Systemic classification: >= 3 weak concepts across >= 3 systems', async () => {
  const { AtRiskClassifierService } = await import(
    '../../features/analytics/services/AtRiskClassifierService'
  );
  const result = AtRiskClassifierService.classify(
    4,
    new Map(), // no shared roots
    new Set(['cardiovascular', 'renal', 'neuro', 'respiratory']),
  );
  expect(result).toBe('systemic');
});

test('Cluster classification: >= 2 weak concepts sharing prerequisite', async () => {
  const { AtRiskClassifierService } = await import(
    '../../features/analytics/services/AtRiskClassifierService'
  );
  const sharedRoots = new Map([['root-1', ['concept-a', 'concept-b']]]);
  const result = AtRiskClassifierService.classify(
    2,
    sharedRoots,
    new Set(['cardiovascular']),
  );
  expect(result).toBe('cluster');
});

test('Isolated classification: 1 weak concept', async () => {
  const { AtRiskClassifierService } = await import(
    '../../features/analytics/services/AtRiskClassifierService'
  );
  const result = AtRiskClassifierService.classify(
    1,
    new Map(),
    new Set(['cardiovascular']),
  );
  expect(result).toBe('isolated');
});

test('On-track classification: zero weak concepts', async () => {
  const { AtRiskClassifierService } = await import(
    '../../features/analytics/services/AtRiskClassifierService'
  );
  const result = AtRiskClassifierService.classify(0, new Map(), new Set());
  expect(result).toBe('on_track');
});

test('API returns at-risk students with classifications', async ({ request }) => {
  const { token } = await getTestToken(request, 'faculty');
  const res = await request.get('/api/admin/analytics/at-risk?institution_id=test-inst-id', {
    headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` },
  });
  expect(res.status()).toBe(200);
  const { data } = await res.json();
  expect(data.students).toBeDefined();
  expect(data.summary).toBeDefined();
  for (const student of data.students) {
    expect(['systemic', 'cluster', 'isolated', 'on_track']).toContain(student.classification);
  }
});

test('Negative: student role cannot access at-risk analytics', async ({ request }) => {
  const { token } = await getTestToken(request, 'student');
  const res = await request.get('/api/admin/analytics/at-risk?institution_id=test-inst-id', {
    headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` },
  });
  expect(res.status()).toBe(403);
});
```
